verdicts.title: On cumulative entropies in terms of moments of order statistics
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper relations among some kinds of cumulative entropies and moments of order statistics are presented. By using some characterizations and the symmetry of a non negative and absolutely continuous random variable X, lower and upper bounds for entropies are obtained and examples are given.
